summary: This bill permanently allows businesses to include depreciation, amortization, and depletion when calculating the income limitation on their business interest deduction, retroactively effective for tax years beginning after December 31, 2021.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Internal Revenue Code to permanently extend the allowance for depreciation, amortization, or depletion in determining the limitation on business interest. This change would effectively lower the tax burden for businesses by allowing them to deduct more interest expenses, thus reducing their taxable income.

The bill permanently extends a tax-code provision that increases allowable business interest deductions, directly reducing federal revenue and widening the deficit to support manufacturing and Main Street investment. Because the legislation consists solely of this revenue-losing change, the deficit impact is central rather than incidental.
